texts.orig: Chapter 2. Introduction to the Overlay Utility
texts.text: Chapter 2. Introduction to the Overlay Utility

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The Overlay Utility is one of the AFP Utilities that allows you to create electronic form overlays, which can always be printed in their stored format and can be positioned anywhere on the page.
texts.text: The Overlay Utility is one of the AFP Utilities that allows you to create electronic form overlays, which can always be printed in their stored format and can be positioned anywhere on the page.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Using the overlay utility, you can:
texts.text: Using the overlay utility, you can:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Design an overlay interactively on a display.
texts.text: Design an overlay interactively on a display.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The information you defined for an overlay is called a source overlay .
texts.text: The information you defined for an overlay is called a source overlay .

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 2. Save a source overlay in your file.
texts.text: Save a source overlay in your file.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 3. Create an overlay object from a source overlay, which can be printed on the IPDS printers.
texts.text: Create an overlay object from a source overlay, which can be printed on the IPDS printers.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: You can change the design of the overlay by changing the source overlay.
texts.text: You can change the design of the overlay by changing the source overlay.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 1. You cannot directly change the overlay object. You need to change the source overlay and create the overlay object from it.
texts.text: You cannot directly change the overlay object. You need to change the source overlay and create the overlay object from it.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 2. You can work with the overlay object using the resource management utility. See 'Chapter 19. Work with Overlays Function' on page 341 for more information.
texts.text: You can work with the overlay object using the resource management utility. See 'Chapter 19. Work with Overlays Function' on page 341 for more information.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: You can merge the overlay object with various spooled files as your final printout. You can use overlays at any time you want on various types of forms. Thus, you can eliminate the use of preprinted paper forms.
texts.text: You can merge the overlay object with various spooled files as your final printout. You can use overlays at any time you want on various types of forms. Thus, you can eliminate the use of preprinted paper forms.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The overlay can be composed of text, images, graphics, lines, boxes, and bar codes called elements . All of the environmental data (such as font references) is defined as a part of the overlay definition. The fonts defined for the overlay are not influenced by the fonts used for the variable data on the logical page.
texts.text: The overlay can be composed of text, images, graphics, lines, boxes, and bar codes called elements . All of the environmental data (such as font references) is defined as a part of the overlay definition. The fonts defined for the overlay are not influenced by the fonts used for the variable data on the logical page.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The basic function of the overlay is to provide a template-like pattern that establishes fixed data for merging with various spooled files.
texts.text: The basic function of the overlay is to provide a template-like pattern that establishes fixed data for merging with various spooled files.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: For each element, you must specify its position and the horizontal and vertical distances from the overlay origin. You can also specify the offset, and horizontal and vertical distances of the overlay origin from the origin of the page. The initial values are set to zero offset in both directions, which means the overlay origin will coincide with the page origin. This eliminates the need for preprinted paper forms.
